recoveryCases.files: stagenet/recovery-cases.mjs (orchestrator), stagenet/holder-process.mjs (journaled installation as a separate process), stagenet/lossy-proxy.mjs (fault proxy), holder-carrier-recovery.test.mjs
recoveryCases.rule: COMPLETED only with 10 confirmations on chain; uncertain, conflicting, rejected or refused operations are never reported as completed; orchestrator and process exit nonzero on failure

cases.LR: actual lost broadcast reply (daemon answered OK, reply dropped): lookup before retry, nothing re-sent, one fee
cases.LRQ: lost request: lookup unknown, same blob re-sent once
cases.R1a: killed after quote: released, no fee
cases.R1b: killed after proving before signing: signed once on resume
cases.R2: killed after signing before broadcast: same txid sent on resume
cases.R3: killed after an unanswered send: found in pool on resume, nothing re-sent
cases.S: stale signed backup settles from chain (no re-send, no fee); stale built backup with spent notes refused before any carrier
cases.TWO: (offline only) two installations, same phrase, same note: exactly one completed; other refused/rejected
cases.RB: (offline only) completed transfer removed by a 12-block rollback: same carrier re-sent, no new fee; operator-side rollback loss retained (review/05)
